title: Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit Plans — Substitution of a Retired Fleet Unit
content:
# Substitution of a Retired Fleet Unit

Within the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans, a fleet plan whose vehicle is retired from the fleet may be moved to the replacement vehicle where the plan allows fleet substitutions, at most as many times per plan as it allows.

1. The replacement vehicle must itself be eligible under the plan's sale rules and must not already have an active plan.
2. The plan keeps its sale date, expiration date, visits remaining and price.
3. Its expiration odometer is not reset.
4. A fleet plan is moved only while it is active.

**Status of clause 3.** Clause 3 is **no longer in force** for a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan moved onto the unit that replaced its retired unit within the scope of the fleet transfer odometer rule. That scope is the unit delivered on the customer's single Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement standing in closed status. For such a move the expiration odometer is re-based. The plan still keeps its sale date, expiration date, visits remaining and price. Every other move keeps its expiration odometer.

| Request | Result |
|---|---|
| Move an active fleet plan, first substitution, to an eligible replacement with no active plan | Permitted (the Fleet tier allows one substitution) |
| Move the same plan a second time | Not permitted: the limit of one is reached |
| Move a plan that is cancelled, expired or fulfilled | Not permitted: moved only while active |
| Move onto a vehicle that already has an active plan | Not permitted |
| Move a retail Kessler Care plan | Not permitted: retail tiers allow no substitution |

superseded_clauses: its expiration odometer is not reset
